content: This medication should be taken at least two hours apart from other medications to avoid potential interactions. It may take one to three days for the medication to begin working effectively. For optimal results, it is important to use this medication regularly. To help you remember, take it at the same time(s) each day. If your condition persists, worsens, or if you experience rectal bleeding, inform your doctor immediately. Common side effects of this medication may include gas or stomach cramping. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, it is because they have determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Always take this medication with a full glass of water or another liquid (8 ounces or 240 milliliters) to prevent it from swelling in the throat, which could cause choking. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are rare, but if they occur, seek medical attention immediately. This is not a comprehensive list of possible side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for similar guidance. Before using this bulk-forming laxative, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Some formulations may include sugar or aspartame, so caution is advised if you have diabetes, phenylketonuria (PKU), or other conditions requiring dietary restrictions. It is unknown whether this medication passes into breast milk, so consult your doctor if you are breastfeeding. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222 for assistance. Lifestyle changes that may help prevent or relieve constipation include regular exercise, adequate water intake, and a diet rich in fiber, such as bran, fresh fruits, and vegetables. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Different brands of this medication may have different storage requirements. Check the product packaging for specific instructions or consult your pharmacist. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
